nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Serves as the chapter roadmap and table of contents for Chapter 8, introducing architectural governance across lifecycle hooks, cron jobs, heartbeat polling, remote access, and security baselines for 24/7 unattended operations.
nodes.languageNotes: Chapter overview establishing five dimensions of architectural governance required for sustainable unattended operations.

nodes.name: 8.1_hooks.md
nodes.summary: Details OpenClaw lifecycle hooks and event interception points, establishing clear separation of cross-cutting governance concerns like rate limiting, auditing, and data masking while enforcing timeout, degradation, and idempotency constraints.
nodes.languageNotes: Covers gateway hook discovery mechanisms, HOOK.md structure, handler TypeScript files, and diagnostic commands via openclaw hooks.

nodes.name: 8.2_cron_jobs.md
nodes.summary: Guides the design and scheduling of exact-time unattended tasks using built-in gateway cron and external crontab integration, emphasizing idempotency keys, non-overlapping locks, and error triage.
nodes.languageNotes: Differentiates main session events (--system-event) from isolated session tasks (--message) and details jobs.json versus jobs-state.json runtime persistence.

nodes.name: 8.3_heartbeat.md
nodes.summary: Explains OpenClaw's periodic heartbeat mechanism for batched polling and notify-on-demand alerting, dissecting the timer-to-delivery lifecycle, HEARTBEAT_OK protocol, active hours configuration, and token cost optimization.
nodes.languageNotes: Details 250ms debounce merge, per-agent timers, HEARTBEAT.md inspection checklists, and suppression semantics using HEARTBEAT_OK.

nodes.name: 8.4_remote_access.md
nodes.summary: Architects secure remote management for OpenClaw instances using SSH port forwarding, Tailscale Serve private network tunnels, Zero Trust identity principles, and rclone file synchronization.
nodes.languageNotes: Contrasts private Tailscale Serve against public Tailscale Funnel, detailing explicit CLI authentication requirements and remote browser takeover via KasmVNC.

nodes.name: 8.5_security_baseline.md
nodes.summary: Establishes a verifiable defense-in-depth security baseline spanning ingress control, routing bindings, tool execution policies, and secret management with structured audit event logging.
nodes.languageNotes: Formulates a four-tier defense model verified using openclaw doctor, status --deep, and structured JSON log streaming.

nodes.name: summary.md
nodes.summary: Summarizes key operational automation takeaways, provides a practical self-inspection checklist for production readiness, and showcases community deployment patterns.
nodes.languageNotes: Includes self-check items for hooks, cron idempotency, heartbeat quiet hours, remote ingress verification, and previews Chapter 9.
